        } else if (cfg.program && a.target === '_blank' && /^https?:/.test(href) && href.indexOf(location.host) < 0) {
            ga('program_website_click', { program_id: cfg.program.id, program_name: cfg.program.name });
        } else if (cfg.topic && /\/summer-programs\//.test(href) && a.closest('.gm-filters, .gm-dd')) {
            ga('filter_select', { topic: cfg.topic, to: href.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/, '') });
        }
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        var f = e.target;
        if (f && f.classList && f.classList.contains('gm-tsearch')) {
            var q = f.querySelector('input[name="q"]');
            ga('program_search', { search_term: q ? q.value.slice(0, 80) : '' });
        }
    }, true);
})();

(function () {
    /* Measure what actually sits on top of our page (a fixed, absolute or
       overlapping header): look straight down from the top of our page until we
       see our own content, then move our page down by that much. */
    function fit() {
        var main = document.querySelector('main.gm-modern');
        if (!main || window.scrollY > 5) { return; }
        main.style.paddingTop = '';
        var top = main.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        var start = Math.max(top, 0) + 2;
        var covered = 0;
        [0.3, 0.5, 0.7].forEach(function (fx) {
            var x = Math.round(window.innerWidth * fx), y = start;
            while (y < Math.min(window.innerHeight, start + 500)) {
                var el = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
                if (!el || main.contains(el)) { break; }
                y += 4;
            }
            if (y < Math.min(window.innerHeight, start + 500)) { covered = Math.max(covered, y - start); }
        });
        if (covered > 4) {
            var base = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(main).paddingTop) || 0;
            main.style.paddingTop = (base + covered + 8) + 'px';
        }
    }
    function run() { fit(); setTimeout(fit, 600); }
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') { run(); } else { window.addEventListener('load', run); }
    var t; window.addEventListener('resize', function () { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(fit, 200); });
})();
</script>
